raw.details:
Overview

Online AI dataset challenge

Organised by Hackyard | In collaboration with Adaption Labs

  • Challenge dates: November 16 - December 6, 2026
  • Format: Fully online
  • Build period: Three weeks
  • Team size: 1-4 members
  • Submission deadline: December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM IST

About the Adaption Dataset Challenge

Build an AI assistant for an underserved language or domain, starting with the data that shapes its behaviour. The Adaption Dataset Challenge brings together builders to create or improve an instruction-tuning dataset, train a model with AutoScientist and measure the result.

Choose a practical problem and the people your assistant will serve. Use Adaption to develop your dataset, test your approach and demonstrate what changed. The focus is on useful data, measurable model improvement and a clear explanation of your work.

Challenge theme

Adapt the data. Then prove it.

Your task is to build an instruction-tuning dataset for an assistant in an underserved language or domain. You choose the use case. Possible directions include:

  • A question-answering assistant for an underserved language.
  • An assistant that explains a specialised topic or service in accessible language.
  • A domain-specific assistant for a clearly defined group of users.

These are examples, not compulsory tracks. Explain the problem, your intended users and the assistant behaviour you want to improve.

Stage 1: Register and Create Your Adaption Account

Register for the challenge once, on Unstop or Hackyard. Then create your Adaption account at https://adaptionlabs.ai/app using the same email you registered with. You can do this right away. Existing Adaption users keep their existing account.

Hackyard shares participant emails with Adaption for challenge-related account access, credit allocation and participation verification. Adaption's platform records are used to verify account and dataset activity. No screenshot or PDF is needed.

Join the challenge WhatsApp group for participant updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/DyiXXOZ4ATJ7xVRUpxyKn8?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Challenge registration is needed on only one platform: Unstop or Hackyard. Participants registered through Hackyard should not register again on Unstop.

Stage 2: Participant Onboarding with Adaption

An online onboarding session with Adaption is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:30 PM IST / 9:00 AM EST.

The session covers account setup, dataset preparation, Invent a Dataset, Adaptive Data and AutoScientist. The session is private, and its recording will be shared with registered participants only.

Adaption will provide the platform access and resources needed to build datasets and train models during the challenge. Start with the documentation at https://docs.adaptionlabs.ai/ and the welcome deck and quickstart linked on the challenge website.

Stage 3: Adaption Dataset Challenge - Build & Submit

Build from November 16 to December 6, 2026. Choose an assistant use case in an underserved language or domain, create or improve your dataset with Adaption, train a model with AutoScientist and evaluate the result.

Submit by December 6, 2026, at 11:59 PM IST. Share one link containing:

  • Your dataset created or improved on Adaption.
  • Details of the model trained with AutoScientist.
  • Your use case, intended users and expected assistant behaviour.
  • How you used Adaption, including features, settings and iterations.
  • Evaluation results, with a baseline comparison where agreed.
  • A README or write-up covering your approach, data source and licence, results, limitations and team members.
  • A demo of the assistant and the work completed.

Submit your final project once, on one platform only: here on Unstop or on your team's page in the Hackyard app at https://app.hackyard.org/e/adaption-labs.

You keep ownership of what you build. Your submission is shared with Hackyard and Adaption for verification and judging.

Challenge format

  • Define your use case and prepare a seed dataset that you have the right to use and adapt.
  • Create or improve your instruction-tuning data on Adaption using Invent a Dataset and/or Adaptive Data.
  • Train a model using AutoScientist.
  • Evaluate the result using an approach agreed with Adaption and provide evidence for any improvement you claim.
  • Demonstrate the assistant and submit your dataset, model details, evaluation and documentation by the deadline.

Required use of Adaption

Dataset preparation or generation: Use Invent a Dataset and/or Adaptive Data to create or improve your instruction-tuning dataset. Record the features, settings and iterations you use.

Model training: Train your model with AutoScientist and explain how the dataset supports the intended task.

Evaluation and demonstration: Show how the model performs, include a baseline comparison where agreed and demonstrate the assistant.

Only submissions that use Adaption in their tool stack are eligible for the $100 first-place cash prize. If there is no eligible project, the cash prize will not be awarded.

Eligibility and team formation

  • Participants must be at least 18 years old to use Adaption.
  • Enter solo or in a team of up to four, as listed on Unstop.
  • The challenge is fully online and open worldwide, subject to applicable laws and Adaption's platform terms.
  • Team-change rules will be covered in the final participant rules.

Dataset guidelines

  • Use instruction/response pairs or chat-style data in a format Adaption supports.
  • Use public data or data your team creates only when you have the right to use and adapt it. Name the source and licence.
  • Do not include personal, confidential or unauthorised data, or unsafe or illegal content.
  • Follow Adaption's documentation and onboarding guidance for supported formats and size limits.

Judging

Hackyard runs judging. Adaption verifies signups and dataset runs, and a judge from Adaption's team joins the final round. Projects are assessed on:

  • Dataset quality: relevance, quality and suitability for the use case.
  • Measurable model improvement: evidence of improvement on the intended task using an evaluation method agreed with Adaption.
  • Relevance of the use case: a clear problem, intended users and practical value.
  • Clarity of the write-up: an understandable account of decisions, workflow, results and limitations.

Prizes and Adaption-sponsored benefits

  • 1st place: $100 cash for the team, two VIP swag boxes and an additional $1,000 in Adaption platform credits per member.
  • 2nd place: Swag boxes and an additional $1,000 in Adaption platform credits per member.
  • 3rd place: Swag boxes and an additional $1,000 in Adaption platform credits per member.
  • Unstop certificates: Participation certificates for participants registered on Unstop, and winner certificates for teams placing 1st to 3rd.

All amounts are in US dollars. Platform credits have no cash value and cannot be transferred, resold or exchanged for money.

Swag ships after results are final. Winners will be asked for their name, shipping address and phone number for delivery.

Dates and deadlines

  • November 16, 2026: Challenge starts and submissions open.
  • November 18, 2026: Participant onboarding, 7:30 PM IST / 9:00 AM EST.
  • December 6, 2026: Registration and submissions close; submission deadline is 11:59 PM IST.
  • December 7-13, 2026: Verification and judging.
  • Results date: To be announced.

These dates are planned and may change. Check the official challenge updates for any revisions.

Event information and participant data

Challenge information and resources: https://hackyard.org/events/adaption-labs

Challenge WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/DyiXXOZ4ATJ7xVRUpxyKn8?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Questions: hello@hackyard.org

Hackyard shares participant email addresses with Adaption for challenge-related account access, credit allocation and participation verification. Further details will be provided in the final participant rules and applicable privacy notices. Adaption's standard terms and privacy policy apply when you create an account.

Register for the Adaption Dataset Challenge

Choose a problem that matters, build the data, train your model and show the improvement. Register here on Unstop, create your Adaption account with your registered email to get started.

Adaption Dataset Challenge: Adapt the data. Then prove it.
